answers.llm or nlp system .*production: Not yet in a production team. The closest is KWealth, a personal four-agent stock analysis system in Python that I built and ran myself: a data scout feeds bull and bear analyst agents in parallel, and a synthesizer weighs both memos. Gemini outputs are validated into Pydantic models (ScoutReport, AnalystMemo, FinalRecommendation) with a 0.0-1.0 confidence score and caveats, and it handles invalid tickers, Gemini 503s and timeouts. I owned all of it; it is a personal project, not used by external users. https://github.com/iamkhalid2/kwealth
answers.demanding python data or model pipeline: Not at production scale yet. The most demanding is Invent a GPT, a 19-chapter course that rebuilds Karpathy's 200-line pure-Python GPT. Learners run real Python in the browser through Pyodide, and chapter 16 trains the real microgpt.py on a 32,033-name dataset in the browser. Deployed as a static site to GitHub Pages via GitHub Actions. Reliability challenge: making the in-browser model match the Python implementation, which I solved by checking every exercise with hidden tests and verifying the in-browser model against Python reference outputs. https://iamkhalid2.github.io/microgpt-course
